newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Seloga sees 135 mln ringgit govt deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Seloga sees 135 mln ringgit govt deal.

text.p: The soon-to-be-listed Malaysian company Seloga Holdings Bhd expects to get a 135 million ringgit construction contract with the government within two weeks, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.
The contract is for construction of buildings at five locations in the country.
"Negotiations are in the final stages," Chan Nung Wai told reporters.
Seloga, which completed its share offering recently, was oversubscribed 34 times.
The shares are expected to be listed on the second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on December 10.
Seloga was negotiating for a 16-hectare site in the Klang Valley for housing development, said Chan.
The company is currently developing three projects around the country, one each on the offshore financial centre on Labuan island, the northern state of Pahang and in Kuala Lumpur, said Chan.
